stories.text: scenario result 明确区分 `status` 与 `closure_outcome`，不再把 status 当成 closure truth
scenario result 明确包含 `confidence_raw`、`confidence_calibrated`、`confidence_band` 与 review flag
AC closure 由 required scenario families、replay、evidence sufficiency、confidence threshold 与 unresolved outcomes 推导
高风险 browser scenario 自动放行前必须同时具备 deterministic replay、browser evidence pack 与 calibrated confidence threshold
Beacon 正式支持 `review_required`、`needs_more_evidence`、`needs_replay`、`needs_requirement_clarification`
scenario result 正式支持 `spec_gap / implementation_gap / runner_gap / environment_gap / flake / evidence_gap`
`.beacon/qa/features/<feature>/ac-closure.json` 作为正式 machine artifact 被定义
`.beacon/qa/features/<feature>/scorecard.json` 正式表达 closure、confidence、review count 与 false-complete risk
release scorecard 使用 calibrated confidence、review count、needs_replay、open outcomes 决定 `release_ready`
`.beacon/state/qa-audits/<run_id>/<scenario_id>.json` 作为 sampled audit truth artifact 被定义
benchmark corpus 至少覆盖 false pass、false block、stale evidence、missing replay、wrong delta rerun、story/AC trace mismatch
QA precision 优化面只允许 scenario expansion、delta selection、evidence sufficiency、confidence calibration 与 release thresholds
keep/discard experiment 必须固定预算、可比较、可回滚，不能演变为整仓自治
v1.1.10 不替换 deterministic replay，不允许把 LLM judgement 变成唯一 truth source
v1.1.10 扩展而不破坏 v1.1.9 QA contracts、v1.1.7 project skill/profile/orchestration、v1.1.8 `technical-implementation-*` 归档面
目标项目可通过 profile/skill binding、verify orchestration、required evidence gate 声明项目专属 QA workflow，并在 operator surfaces 中被解释清楚
`qa run <feature>` 主链直接消费 profile binding、verify orchestration 与 required evidence gate，而不是要求操作者手工走平行 `verify run`
browser QA session manifest 支持保存 `profile_ref / cookies_ref / storage_state_ref / scopes / expiry`，并可供后续 QA/replay/workflow 复用
QA 缺陷、review-required outcome 或 release block 可路由到 `beacon implement`，并产出 `technical-implementation-*`、requirement rewrite input 与 architecture feedback
QA test feedback 必须能回写 benchmark truth、audit drift、candidate surface、project skill evolution input 与 next experiment set；同时 machine refresh 默认不得覆盖人工编写的 QA requirement docs
